full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned pictorial photograph shows two dark figures standing close together at the edge of a still misty lake. The upper left is almost empty, filled with pale gray-brown fog that erases the far shore. At the upper right, a tree trunk and a canopy of dark leaves lean into the frame, shading the narrow bank below. The land juts leftward as an irregular stone-edged point near the center, ending in a flat slab just above the water. Two people stand near the outer edge of that point, small against the broad pale mist. One figure has a long skirt and a rounded hat or dark hair shape; the other wears a shorter dark coat and straight trousers. Their heads incline toward one another, and the bodies nearly touch. Because they are backlit, facial details and exact clothing textures remain hidden in silhouette. The rocky shore runs diagonally from the lower right toward the pair, with thin dark cracks and uneven slabs visible before it disappears into fog. Below the figures, their elongated reflections descend into the calm water as two nearly continuous dark forms. The reflected tree and shore also frame the right side of the lake, while the left half remains broad and open. The water has only the slightest tonal ripple, preserving a soft mirror image without a bright horizon line. Light comes diffusely from the fog and open sky across the lake, making the background almost white and reducing the pair and tree to deep brown-black. The photograph is softly focused with fine grain and gentle tonal transitions, and its edges fade into mist rather than cutting sharply. No readable sign or built structure is visible. The overall composition places a tiny private encounter within an expansive reflection and empty air, using silhouette and sepia softness for a quiet, nostalgic mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色画意摄影描绘两道深色身影紧靠着站在静止的雾湖边。左上方几乎空无一物，浅灰棕色雾气抹去了远岸。右上方，树干和一片深色树冠斜伸进画框，遮住下方狭窄岸地。陆地在中央附近形成一处不规则石边岬角，向左伸出，尽头是一块紧贴水面上方的平石板。两人站在岬角外缘附近，在宽阔浅色雾气前显得很小。一人穿长裙，头上有圆帽或深发形状；另一人穿较短的深色外套和直筒长裤。两颗头彼此倾斜，身体几乎相触。由于逆光，面容细节和衣料的确切质感隐藏在剪影中。石岸从右下向两人斜伸，细深裂缝和不平整石板在没入雾气前仍可辨。人物下方，拉长的倒影作为两道几乎连贯的深色形体落入平静水中。树和岸的倒影也框住湖面右侧，左半部则保持宽阔开放。水面只有最轻微的明暗涟漪，保留柔软镜像，却没有明亮地平线。光从湖面上的雾和开阔天空漫射而来，让背景近乎白色，把人物与树木压成深棕黑。照片焦点柔和，带细颗粒与轻柔的明暗过渡，边缘消入雾中，而非锐利切断。没有可读招牌或建筑。整体构图把一场微小私密的相遇置于宽阔倒影和空旷空气中，以剪影与棕褐柔光形成安静怀旧的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The pictorial photograph uses a warm sepia monochrome, very soft focus, and broad areas of pale mist. Dark silhouettes occupy a small portion of the frame, gaining weight from their strong contrast with open luminous space. Diffuse backlight removes local color and most surface detail, leaving pose, overlap, and outline to carry the image. A nearly still reflective plane doubles the darkest shapes vertically, creating quiet symmetry beneath an irregular diagonal shoreline. Foreground texture appears in a few rough dark marks, then dissolves toward the distant haze. Fine grain and gently veiled edges give the image a tactile old-print quality rather than modern sharpness. Tonal transitions remain slow across empty areas, with no hard spotlight or crisp horizon. The overall effect is intimate and nostalgic, using scale, reflection, and negative space to let a small encounter feel suspended in time.
style_prompt_zh: 这种画意摄影使用暖棕褐单色、很柔和的焦点和大片浅色雾气。深色剪影只占画面小部分，却因与开放的发光空间形成强烈对比而有重量。漫射逆光抹去局部颜色和大部分表面细节，留下姿态、遮挡与轮廓承载图像。几乎静止的反光平面把最深的形状向下竖向复制，在不规则斜向岸线下形成安静对称。前景肌理以少数粗糙深色记号出现，随后向远处薄雾消散。细颗粒和轻罩的边缘赋予图像可触的旧印相质感，而非现代式锐度。空旷区域的明暗过渡缓慢，没有硬聚光或清晰地平线。整体效果亲密而怀旧，以尺度、倒影与留白使微小相遇仿佛悬停在时间里。

reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
